notes.title: Alpha 2.0 coming soon!
notes.notes:
[p]Heads up!
Alpha 2.0 is getting close, and its so different, its basically a new game! 
Here are some of the features coming in Alpha 2.0:
+Brand new inventory system including rarities, durability, updated mechanics and graphics along with integration into several other systems such as transport ships and your equipment load-out. 
+Vehicles! You can now use vehicles to travel the map and explore or take on harder challenges. 
+Tons of updated content both visually and internally with their code. 
+The entire game is now converted over from the old version (RTS/3rd Person Shooter single player) to the new and improved version (3rd person action/shooter multiplayer). This means you can play with friends on the same maps and work together to complete missions! 
+Missions! These are brand new. You will have to complete these missions to unlock new maps. They offer tons of loot, xp and resources. 
+Character creator! Make your own commander, and then make a different one, or another one! You can have different commanders and level them up with different stats, skills and abilities offering a huge range of ways to play the game and specialize in different areas. 
+Brand new enemies and enemy A.I. systems.
+Massive new maps that let players explore and go much further for as long as they want. No more time limits! 
+A new Homeworld that lets players have a safe base where they can add decorations, customize buildings and do crafting. 
+New Resources to harvest and collect and a whole new harvesting system allowing for players to harvest pretty much anything they see![/p][p]+New UI and HUD allowing players to easily move some windows around and navigate easier! All UI elements easily close upon moving for fast response and use.[/p][p]+New Armor and Equipable items. Equip armor and change your weapons or tools with the new equipment system.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185047/c11f12762f12744dd3fc006e14d2b50c67f8d642.png"][/img] [/p][p]There are a ton of more features to talk about but for now, this is a quick update on whats coming soon! If you already own the game, this update will change your game over to the new version so you have nothing to worry about!   Please note that a lot of these features are very new and are still being worked out so even once 2.0 is launched, expect a ton of bugs and issues to smooth out. If you want to know more or stay in the loop, feel free to join the discord channel for either the game or the studio at the links provided. Thanks!  [/p][p][/p][p]Stars and Empires Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/SZ2nTtTw"]https://discord.gg/SZ2nTtTw[/url] [/p][p]Elemental Legion (studio): [url="https://discord.gg/guCBBf77"]https://discord.gg/guCBBf77[/url] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185047/f2293c45f05493b05d3277e3ec4cfc69c7d1c195.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update version: 1.912
notes.notes:
+Enemies spawned now use the new snap grid system for better accuracy and performance.
+New fortification block added "Gate" that allows building on top similar to walls but can also pass through with the player. Enemies cannot go through the forcefield doorway. 
+Fixed a few other smaller various issues.

notes.title: Update Version: 1.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185047/81d76205c729b9cb71298ef537f3bffbdc1137b7.png[/img]

+New start system for all maps. Players will now have time to survey the map and look around before they choose where to place their core base. Once placed, the countdown will begin. 
+All harvestable resource nodes have been redesigned from the ground up.
+Harvestable resource nodes now spawn randomly each playthrough on each map. 
+New Harvestable Tiers (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary) offering yields related to those rarity types. Chances are more rare to spawn more rare types. 
+New harvestable resource node added “Dimentium” legendary rarity type.
+The amount of available harvestable nodes will slightly increase or decrease your overall possible amount of waves per map. Fewer nodes will lower your amount slightly while more nodes will increase your amount keeping it more fair. 
+New building system. Entire world now uses a snap system for easy building. Construction blocks can now be placed to build your actual base with walls, stairs and any other design you wish. Turrets can now be placed on top of any constructed blocks for better long range sight.
+Many facilities and structures have been rescaled to better fit the scale and pace of the game.
+Original large walls have been rescaled.
+Maximum height for building construction blocks has been set to 5 depending on your natural elevation. 
+New spawning system for enemies, completely redesigned. Uses snap grid system to avoid bad spawns and world fall throughs or odd collisions leading to smarter location selection for spawns.
+Redesigned the tutorial map and process. Cleaner and talks about some new features.

notes.title: Update Version: 1.878
notes.notes:
+New enemy added "Orik". A massive rare beast that can do devastating damage to anything near it. 
+New colony "Boulder Slide" Added. Requires "Rocky Point" colonized to unlock. 
+Enemy spawners slightly modified for better spawn sensing. Better locations and less collisions when spawning enemies to prevent getting stuck. 
+Alerts fixed to show up correctly now. 
+New loot object added to new map, "bones" can be harvested for resources similar to a loot crate.
+All colonies have a hidden tier. The tiers will become visible in a future patch and tiers will also show on creatures soon but for now, the tiers have been rebalanced to only allow appropriate creatures of a tier greater or equal to the tier of the map to make things more balanced. This means you shouldn't see a high tier enemy on a beginner map. 
+Fixed esc ignoring movie skip. Now skips when pressed.

notes.title: Update Version 1.872
notes.notes:
+All the ui core problems have been fixed. The original 1.87 patch has been enhanced with even more improvements and updates. 
+All textures have been updated and multiple performance issues fixed.
+Preloading introduced which will start loading predictively to save time on loads. Loading times should be blazing fast now.
+Fixed several backend issues that may have been causing lag spikes or performance loss. 
+Inventory items optimized. 
+Game is prepped for new unreal engine 5.5 features & updates.

notes.title: Update Version: 1.871
notes.notes:
+rewrote all the code for the ui sub systems. 
+loading is faster for levels with preloading now.
+Fixed several issues with other ui's conflicting, organized all systems and rebuilt them. Should be smooth now.

notes.title: Version 1.86 fixed
notes.notes: There were some major issues with the 1.86 build originally so it had to be rolled back for a few days to sort it all out. All the work is done now and 1.86 should run like normal. Fingers crossed!

notes.title: Update: Version 1.87 [Big UI improvements and fixes]
notes.notes:
+Massive UI upgrades! Completely recoded the entire main UI system. This fixed a bunch of issues and will set up the game for bigger developments and features.
+Music player works now! yay! No more issues with looped songs or discontinued auto play, should work fine. Let me know of course if it acts up but seemed fine during extensive testing. The music player will stop when loading back to the main menu, this will change eventually once the it converts over to a media player but that will be a while out. 
Also cleaned up some of its code to be more optimized and not as heavy.
+Solar system glitch finally solved! This means you should be able to continuously move from finishing 1 map win/fail to another without the solar system view missing UI elements or menus. Long story short, you can play non-stop now and move freely from map to map.
+Fixed compass ui camera bug.
+Updated several assets to new ui system. If you find something isn't showing correctly please let me know.
+Fixed death crate flying into high orbit upon destroying.
+Overall performance should be much better!

notes.title: Update: Version 1.86 [Inventory & Crafting Begins]
notes.notes:
Update: Version 1.86
+Meteor explosions now destroy wildlife (resources).
+Fixed some bugs with creatures.
+Added new inventory system, still very new, "craftable resources" now drop and can be collected. Can be used to craft items with eventually at a fabricator. 
You can test this at the new "homeland" area. 
+Homeland unlocked but super new, will be developed extensively moving forward. Will serve as a sandbox for players to build, upgrade and craft with other features.
Inventory will soon be opening up into more options and features big time, especially in the homeland area. 
+New inventory UI system with searching options. 
+Inventory can be dropped, equipped or used depending on the item. (Only drop works currently).
+New "area" pickup ability by pressing F near "dropped items only" will allow you to pick them all up at once. This will come into play later on especially during fast trading/building with other players. 
-Some other news: Vehicles are really close to being added. This will allow players to craft actual fully functional and controllable vehicles in the game such as battle tanks and hover boards. Everything (including weapons and armor) will use durability. 
+Blueprints are live, you can find them but keep in mind they are not functional yet. Blueprints are used to craft items and required "craftable resources" (not the same as standard resources you get for building on a colony) and only drop from enemies. 
So start saving up your resources now and get ready cause crafting/vehicles/weapons and more are all on the way! 
+Only being VICTORIOUS on a colony map will "sync" (save)  your collected inventory. This is to prevent easy in/out farming. There WILL be maps that players will use for grinding but they are not ready yet, they will be more of a sandbox format.
Please keep in mind inventory is brand new and nothing is truly safe just yet. 
Expect rapid updates for balancing as we progress from here.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.853
notes.notes:
+New Discovery Added "Tree of Wisdom" which can unlock new tech.
+Updated discovery icons in your collection and how they are displayed. Includes new search bar to look for ones you have. Ones you don't have will show as darker so you know what you are missing. 
+Updated artifacts window to use a search bar.
+Updated perks window to use a search bar.
+Fixed an issue where future patch content was dropping as loot briefly.  Should be fixed now.

notes.title: Update Version 1.852
notes.notes:
Update: Version 1.852
+Fixed an issue with the ui blocking the vitals with the equipment loadout. Ive been moving things around so some ui adjustments/issues are expected as we get closer to the new inventory mechanic.
+Preloaded inventory systems phase 2/3 completed. Soon will be able to use a permanent inventory system. This will allow for crafting at certain factories too and use blueprints depending on what you find and collect in the maps.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.851
notes.notes:
+Added some different logic if an enemy gets stuck to reset it (testing).
+Adjusted more sounds for creatures. 
+Added new creatures.
+Changed the animation system for enemies, converted them to the new system being designed. Added tons of optimization to the new system as well. Should be smoother overall and allow for rapid content development and new creatures faster.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.85
notes.notes:
+Fixed the issue where some loot dropped would fall through the world. Will auto fix itself now if this occurs with "smart" loot.
+Fixed bug where volume for sfx/music wasn't saving correctly.
+Started with phase 1 of vehicle driving/control/crafting. Will unlock in the game eventually. 
+Loot system slowly converting over to a new one that will allow for full integration with the players storage and crafting. Lots of back end code being worked on to prepare for a big content push soon. 
+Loot beacons updated, will now show beacon colors based on rarity of the item dropped. Right now only resources can drop but soon tons of other items. As for resources, higher rarity = more of that item so higher amounts of resources in this case.
+New tab "inventory" added to tab menu. Will soon allow for searching of items owned. 
+New Enemies added!
+Some enemy physics adjusted, new enemy animation system being designed. Old enemies will start being replaced in future patches from this point.
+Enemy attack sounds will start to be rolled out in the next few patches.
+Fixed some footstep sounds with enemies not working correctly. 
+Replaced primary weapon, trying a few things. New bullet effects and looks.
+Loadout Equipped menu changed, slowly converting to a new system for swapping equipment with inventory eventually.

notes.title: Update Version: 1.84
notes.notes:
+Natural Disaster % chance reduced from 15% per map to around 3%. Considering there will be numerous disaster events they will all mainly pool from this same % chance system. These are not the same as threats.
+Added more destructive systems to assets
+Added more sfx to destructive systems.
+Small lift to solar system appearance and ui. New planet added, will eventually be next planet to play on. 
+Adjusted damage from weather to now apply to shields first, then health. 
+Have started to prepare for eventual major overhaul of solar system back code, planet/map selection and communication between all the assets. This will eventually allow for much more detail such as planets having different day/night cycles, certain weather systems only appearing on certain planet climates and much more. This will take some time to slowly switch over to the new system but is being started now. 
+New Achievement added "Meteor Shower" given to anyone who witnesses a meteor shower! 
+Natural Disasters and Events are being recoded to expand aggressively with new future content. Will allow for rapid development of these events. 
+Added a caution window that pops up if you select "new" on the main menu. This will remind you that pressing new resets ALL progress. Anyone playing on their save should always press "continue" and never new unless you want a fresh start.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.83
notes.notes:
+Elementium visuals lifted a bit, now glow at night.
+Open plains map updated/balanced better. 
+Events can now give you progress points if they occur. Events come from threats or bad weather. So now if you get a nasty blizzard, at least you will get some extra credit if you make it to the end. 
+Victory screen now shows events and their points. 
+Music Player Updates!
Music player will now auto move to next track when one completes.
Music player can swap to any song selected and will update correctly on track list visuals. 
Music player will auto move to first track if playlist finishes. 
More music added to playlist. Albums: Epic Soundtrack Volume 1, 2 & 3, Ascend, The Unknown and more (that's like over 100 more songs) all added to the playlist.
+Lighting on outposts & turrets will turn on automatically if in bad weather or dark outside as will other assets moving forward.
+All maps day cycles have been re-adjusted. 10minutes daytime/5 minutes nighttime. 
+A new natural disaster event has been added... its chances of happening are random. Threat has no effect on this type of event.

notes.title: Update Version: 1.82
notes.notes:
+Entire discovery system has been remade. Discoveries may have to be rediscovered after this update. From now on discoveries will remain permanent once found. So if you find a discovery, you will have it forever and can only benefit once. Each discovery offers a massive boost in colony progress once found.
+New save system being designed for better performance and rapid saving with other systems. First off, it will start saving your discoveries now as well as your colony progress but now also will save your settings that you had when you last saved. This means if your volume is set to 2% when you saved, then when you click continue, it will load those settings. 
+Settings page (from escape menu) has been revamped. Now includes toggle buttons to invert your mouse control in design mode for left/right, up/down, zooming in/out and showing tips (tips will be added later so nothing happens yet with tips). 
+Perks updated, they now show the % buff they give you on their icon. I may change these icons several times and make them different, not sure of the design yet in the perk collection window (tab). Work in progress. 
+Added perks to some newer maps and fixed a few perks not being correctly added if owned. 
+Discovery Achievement now works, just have to find one to claim it!
+Shields Up Achievement now works, get those shields up!
+The Butcher Achievement now works, get slaying!
+Greedy Achievement now works, get 100k of all resources at once!
+Added "press f to interact" prompt when looking at an interactable object as well as other helpful popups like harvestable nodes and loot crates. 
+Fixed a bug where shields were charging over the max allowed briefly. 
+Fixed a bunch of issues with tech not updating correctly in the tech requirements section when needing discoveries or artifacts as a requirement. The data now works correctly. 
+Fixed a serious bug with invasions having the chance to cause a game crash.

notes.title: Update: version 1.81
notes.notes:
+Reworked some code on foliage removal to prevent crashing and increase performance. 
+Fixed a critical error for lower end gpu's crashing from hair on the character. :skeptical: Should be better now and have higher performance overall.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.8b
notes.notes: I broke some code with one of the new attempts to simplify foliage removal so i had to alter it a bit to prevent crashes. Should be fixed now.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.8a
notes.notes:
+Trying new method for UI solar system view bug. 
+Adjusted all assets built and enemies spawned to smooth out foliage decay so its not as laggy when this occurs. Testing some new methods here. Enemies will gradually wear down foliage instead of clearing everything instantly every time. Will be a bit more natural for dense areas. 
+Adjusted the perks for colonies, all health bonuses now.
+Fixed a few colonies not having proper perk types.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.8
notes.notes:
+Updated/Balanced harvest drones pulling way too many resources at once which caused performance hits and potential crashes. Now harvests 1 resource at a time. Should help with better balance and performance. 
+Fixed all audio/sounds/music to respect the volume controls. Some sounds were not respecting volume controls before. 
+Fixed a broken discord invite link in main escape menu.
+Updated tech research window to stay focused while having a text box search term each update or purchase on the same page. (prevents the page from resetting)
+Weather balanced a bit. Getting bad weather will decrease the length it will last with the new max being about 4 minutes instead of 10 minutes. Passive weather can still last a max of 10 minutes. All weather cycles will last at least 3 minutes either way though. 
+Fixed harvest drone bug where it wasn't harvesting the correct amount if the health of the harvest node dropped below 0. Now accurate.
+Adjusted Z hotkey that swaps modes to auto remove tech window upon pressing for convenience. 
+Trying a different ui method to fix the loading of the game after a victory screen. This is a work in progress but may be fixed in this patch. Requires further testing. 
+Added new hotkey "V" which will go to a factory if you have one similar to how the commander button works with auto moving the camera in design mode.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.79E
notes.notes:
Update: Version 1.79e

+Fixed issue where outpost wasn't giving buff to protect from bad weather.
